Market today:
Strong earnings from CrowdStrike and Salesforce are lifting the software and broader tech sector, creating a positive mood. However, the upcoming Fed speech on Friday is the key macro driver to watch, as it could shift sentiment quickly.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-51.65%) and SPAL (-39.28%) are both leveraged ETFs showing significant drawdowns. Given you're on margin, these amplified losses need immediate attention. All other holdings look fine today.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the market reaction to the Fed's Jackson Hole speech. Also, monitor the chip sector for any follow-through from Marvell's mixed reaction, which could impact your SMH position.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged positions and stay alert to macro shifts.
plays: Review your SOXL and SPAL positions. Given their leveraged nature and deep losses, consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin risk.
Consider adding to CRWD. Strong earnings and a scanner ACCUMULATE setup (entry 223.95-222.7, stop 220.23) make it a compelling play.
